description: Release-local language-profile contract. Each call carries exactly one profile, frozen by G1 in call_manifest.csv and resolved into the call spec by G2A. Profiles constrain spoken dialogue only; canonical gold values, metadata, schema fields and internal planning prose keep their existing English representation. Ordinary code-switching in EN_ZH_MIXED is a profile requirement, never an edge case; targeted cross-language challenges are edge-case language variants in edge_case_catalog.json.

ENGLISH.description: Standard conversational English for both speakers; no added Singlish features.

guidance: Professional English suitable for a private-banking relationship manager.

MANDARIN.description: Pure Mandarin for both speakers. Latin letters appear only inside the rendered K01 identifier (the NRIC/FIN letters); no Arabic digits, currency codes, acronyms or English product names are spoken.

guidance: Every value, product name, currency and order term in Mandarin.
Professional Mandarin suitable for a private-banking relationship manager.

EN_ZH_MIXED.description: English-Mandarin code-switching. The client personally uses substantive English and Mandarin, with at least one meaningful within-turn switch and bilingual speech spread across the conversation. Product names, identifiers, acronyms and currency codes alone never count as substantive use of a language. The employee may use either language and responds coherently without a switching quota.

guidance: Switch at natural clause, sentence or turn boundaries and for financial terms; never by arbitrary word replacement.
No exact word or character quota applies.
Professional; may answer in either language.

mixing_styles.EN_LED: The client speaks mostly English with meaningful Mandarin phrases or clauses.
mixing_styles.ZH_LED: The client speaks mostly Mandarin with meaningful English clauses and terminology.
mixing_styles.BALANCED: The client uses both languages regularly.

SINGLISH.description: English-based colloquial Singapore English for the client only; the employee speaks professional English without added Singlish phrasing. No Chinese characters and no deliberate Mandarin or Hokkien switching.

guidance: Singaporean colloquial grammar and romanised discourse particles (lah, lor, leh, ah) may appear where they fit naturally; never inserted mechanically or to a quota.
Still sounds like a private-banking client, not a caricature.
Financial instructions, dates, quantities and compliance meaning are preserved exactly.
Professional English without added Singlish phrasing.

NRIC.formal: 新加坡国民身份证号码
NRIC.note: 身份证号码 is permitted in ordinary dialogue where the context is clear.

terminology.note: Labels describe the identifier; they never change the canonical NRIC/FIN value, which keeps its exact letters and digits.
